## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
`app/legacy/fetch.py` must come down to the 3-attempt retry cap before merge, because the exemption it relies on is added by this same pull request and is not a rule in force. No other defect was found in the health probe or the tests, which this review read but did not run.

## Changes
Adds `app/legacy/fetch.py` (inventory fetch with up to 8 attempts) and `app/health.py` (health probe with up to 3 attempts), with parametrized tests for both in `tests/test_retries.py`. Also adds a sentence to `docs/review-rules.md` exempting modules under `app/legacy/` from the retry cap.

## Critical
- app/legacy/fetch.py:7 — correctness — Cap legacy fetcher retries at 3 attempts — When the legacy service is unreachable, `fetch_inventory` makes 8 attempts, breaking `docs/review-rules.md:5`: "Code that retries a network call must stop after at most 3 attempts." The exemption at `docs/review-rules.md:7` is added by this pull request, so this review treats it as a change, not a rule. — Each call can hold a worker thread for up to 87 seconds (8 ten-second timeouts plus 7 one-second delays) while the upstream is down. — Fix: Set `MAX_ATTEMPTS` to 3, update the expected count at `tests/test_retries.py:10`, and remove `docs/review-rules.md:7`; or land the exemption as its own approved policy change first.
